title: Private DR: storage backend adapters for S3 + MinIO (SSE options) + IAM examples
author: Diego Santos
release_notes:
- Private DR toolkit now supports writing backup artifacts to S3-compatible object storage (AWS S3 + MinIO).
- Adds server-side encryption configuration (SSE-S3 and SSE-KMS where supported) and sample least-privilege IAM policies.
- Adds unit tests + a small integration test harness for upload/download/list/lock semantics.
description: Summary: Introduces pluggable storage backend adapters for `rw-private-dr` backups/restores with first-class support for AWS S3 and MinIO (S3-compatible). Adds server-side encryption options (SSE-S3 and SSE-KMS for AWS), minimal IAM policy examples, and a small integration test harness to validate end-to-end behavior in CI. Motivation: ENG-4834/ENG-4841 require a supported storage target matrix that works in restricted networks and on-prem. We also saw repeated AccessDenied issues (SUP-18442) due to overly-broad or incorrect IAM; this PR includes copy/paste examples and better error messages to reduce operator thrash. Design notes: Adds `StorageBackend` interface with implementations `S3Backend` (aws-sdk-go-v2) and `MinioBackend` (minio-go). The backend is selected via `rw-private-dr.yaml` (`storage.type: s3|minio`) and produces a common layout: `s3://<bucket>/<prefix>/<cluster_id>/<backup_id>/...` including a `manifest.json` and checksum file. Encryption: For AWS S3 we support `encryption.mode: sse-s3 | sse-kms` with `encryption.kms_key_arn` required for sse-kms. For MinIO we support `encryption.mode: sse-s3` only (no client-provided keys in this release). All encryption configuration is validated client-side and echoed in `backup verify` output (no secrets). TLS is enforced for remote endpoints (http is only allowed for localhost/minio integration tests). IAM: Adds `docs/iam/backup-writer-policy.json` and `docs/iam/backup-reader-policy.json` with least-privilege actions (ListBucket scoped to prefix + object Get/Put/Delete as needed). Also includes guidance on VPC endpoints vs public S3 and a note on KMS key policy requirements (kms:Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey + kms:ViaService condition). Testing: Unit tests cover path building, manifest + checksum writing, encryption headers, and error classification. Integration test harness (`hack/itest/storage/`) spins up MinIO and LocalStack, then runs a minimal upload/download/list cycle with the same code paths used by the CLI. LocalStack coverage is intentionally narrow (we're mainly asserting request shape and object layout). Rollout: This is additive. No changes to existing backup formats. Docs will be linked from the Confluence overview once merged.
commits: dr/storage: introduce StorageBackend interface + common layout helpers
dr/storage/s3: implement S3Backend using aws-sdk-go-v2 (Put/Get/List/Delete) + SSE headers
dr/storage/minio: implement MinioBackend using minio-go; enforce TLS for non-local endpoints
config: add storage + encryption schema + validation; improve CLI error messages for AccessDenied
docs: add least-privilege IAM policy examples + KMS notes
tests: unit tests for adapters + manifest/checksum behavior
itest: add LocalStack/MinIO harness; wire into CI workflow
review_conversation: Marcus Lin (security): Please do NOT add support for SSE-C (customer-provided keys) in the first pass. It's too easy to leak key material via logs/env. Also make sure we don't allow plaintext HTTP endpoints except local dev/test; add explicit validation. — Diego Santos (author): Agree. Removed SSE-C mention from docs and config. Added validation: `endpoint` must be https:// unless it resolves to localhost/127.0.0.1 and `allow_insecure_localhost=true` (itest only). Also added log redaction for storage creds and ensured we never print KMS key ARNs at debug-level unless `--verbose` is set.

Hanae Suzuki (security): For sse-kms, make sure we fail fast if kms_key_arn is missing, and surface a clear message about key policy vs IAM. — Diego Santos: Added schema requirement + error message that links to `docs/private-dr/storage-targets.md#kms-policy` and suggests checking `kms:ViaService` and key policy grants.

Bruno Silva (solutions): Can we include an explicit example for a cross-account role (customer backup bucket in a separate account)? We hit this in a pilot-like environment recently. — Diego Santos: Added a short section in the storage doc with the required trust relationship and a note that the bucket policy must allow the role ARN; kept it minimal and pointed to Terraform PR for full topology.

Sahana Iyer (CI): LocalStack occasionally flakes on ListObjectsV2 consistency. Can we reduce flake risk? — Diego Santos: Updated itest to include a small retry/backoff on list + switched the assertion to 'eventually contains' within 10s. Also gated itest behind a separate job so reruns are cheap.

Reviewer note (Marcus Lin): Please confirm that the encryption mode is persisted in the backup manifest so `backup verify` can assert expectations. — Diego Santos: Manifest now includes `storage.encryption.mode` + (for sse-kms) `kms_key_arn_hash` (SHA256 of ARN) to avoid leaking raw ARN while still allowing 'same key' checks.
post_merge_followups: ENG-4860: Terraform examples for S3+KMS wiring (this PR only includes JSON policy examples).
ENG-4869: Ensure backup metrics include storage backend + encryption mode labels (avoid high-cardinality labels like bucket name).
ENG-4912: Validate MinIO behavior in an air-gapped environment with customer staging repo constraints.
